notes: *thy* before *lips* is `added` because שָׂפָם carries no suffix; the contrast with the suffixed *thy headtire* and *thy feet* in the same verse confirms the reading.
דֹּם carries the whole *but not aloud*, since no waw stands in the clause to license the connective; the head is a genuine tie between *not* and *aloud* and the unit note records it.
